APPROVE
Judging from the diff alone (I couldn't read the repository, so I couldn't build it or run the analyzer), the extracted helpers keep the original evaluation order and short-circuiting, so behaviour is unchanged, and removing the nested ternary chain, the `&&` lookup condition and the switch expression takes roughly 13 points off the original 28 to bring it to about 15, assuming `name`/`tail` are `Match` and `lines` is `string[]` as the new signatures require.
